subject: Prime number
prompt: A natural number greater than 1 that IS the product of two smaller natural numbers goes by what name?
why: A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that is not a product of two smaller natural numbers. A natural number greater than 1 that is not prime is called a composite number.

subject: IPhone
prompt: Apple's smartphone line, which runs the company's own mobile operating system, had its first generation announced by which Apple co-founder, then CEO?
why: The iPhone is a line of smartphones developed by Apple that run iOS. The first-generation iPhone was announced by then-Apple CEO and co-founder Steve Jobs.

subject: French language
prompt: A Romance language whose closest relatives are the langues d'oil, it belongs to which language family?
why: French is a Romance language of the Indo-European family. Like all other Romance languages, its closest relatives are the langues d'oil.

subject: Arabic
prompt: A Central Semitic language of the Afroasiatic family, it is so varied that the ISO assigns separate language codes to how many of its varieties?
why: Arabic is a Central Semitic language of the Afroasiatic language family spoken primarily in the Arab world. The International Organization for Standardization assigns language codes to 32 varieties of Arabic.

subject: Bonnie and Clyde
prompt: This pair of Depression-era outlaws travelled the central United States with their gang until both were killed on the same day. In which year?
why: Bonnie Elizabeth Parker (1910-1934) and Clyde Chestnut Barrow (1909-1934) were outlaws who travelled the Central United States with their gang. Both died on 23 May 1934.

subject: Area 51
prompt: This highly classified US Air Force facility sits within the Nevada Test and Training Range. Roughly how far north-northwest of Las Vegas is it?
why: Area 51 is a highly classified United States Air Force facility within the Nevada Test and Training Range in southern Nevada, 83 miles (134 km) north-northwest of Las Vegas.

subject: Australian Open
prompt: Organised by Tennis Australia and the first of the four majors each year, this tournament is played at which Melbourne venue?
why: The Australian Open is a tennis tournament organised by Tennis Australia annually at Melbourne Park in Melbourne, Victoria. It is the first of the four major tennis tournaments every year.

subject: Dark web
prompt: This World Wide Web content sits on overlay networks that use the Internet but cannot be reached with an ordinary browser. What does reaching it require?
why: The dark web is World Wide Web content that exists on darknets — overlay networks that use the Internet but require specific software, configurations or authorization to access.

subject: DuckDuckGo
prompt: This American software company built its privacy-focused search engine after being founded in 2008 by whom?
why: DuckDuckGo is an American software company focused on online privacy whose flagship product is a search engine of the same name, founded by Gabriel Weinberg in 2008.

subject: Russian language
prompt: Belonging to the Balto-Slavic branch of Indo-European, this tongue is one of how many surviving East Slavic languages?
why: Russian is an East Slavic language belonging to the Balto-Slavic branch of the Indo-European language family. It is one of the four extant East Slavic languages.

subject: Microsoft 365
prompt: This family of productivity software and cloud services from Microsoft was known by what name before it was rebranded?
why: Microsoft 365, previously called Office 365, is a product family of productivity software, collaboration and cloud-based services owned by Microsoft.

subject: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
prompt: Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael and Michelangelo were created by which pair of comic book artists?
why: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles is an American media franchise created by comic book artists Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird, following Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael and Michelangelo.

subject: Pi
prompt: This mathematical constant, roughly 3.14159, expresses the ratio of a circle's circumference to what?
why: The number pi is a mathematical constant approximately equal to 3.14159, the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. It appears in many formulae across mathematics.

subject: Morse code
prompt: This telecommunications method encodes text as standardised sequences of just two different signal durations. What are they called?
why: Morse code is a telecommunications method which encodes text characters as standardized sequences of two different signal durations, called dots and dashes, or dits and dahs.

subject: Tokugawa Ieyasu
prompt: The samurai and daimyo who became Japan's first shogun of a dynasty beginning in 1603 was born under which name?
why: Tokugawa Ieyasu, born Matsudaira Takechiyo (1543-1616), was a Japanese samurai, daimyo and the founder and first shogun of the Tokugawa shogunate, which ruled from 1603.

subject: Los Angeles Lakers
prompt: This Los Angeles basketball team plays in the NBA's Western Conference — in which division?
why: The Los Angeles Lakers are an American professional basketball team based in Los Angeles, competing in the NBA as a member of the Pacific Division of the Western Conference.

subject: True Detective season 4
prompt: The fourth season of this HBO anthology crime drama premiered in January 2024 under which subtitle?
why: The fourth season of True Detective, created by Nic Pizzolatto, premiered on January 14, 2024 on HBO, carrying the subtitle Night Country.
